---
title: "Sunrise vs Sunset Times over the Year"
format: html
engine: knitr
filters:
  - webr
webr:
  packages:
    - suncalc
    - ggplot2
    - dplyr
---

For every day of the chosen year this page computes the sunrise and sunset
times at a given location with the R package
[suncalc](https://cran.r-project.org/package=suncalc) and plots each day as a
point (*x* = sunrise hour, *y* = sunset hour). The red points mark the day with
the earliest sunset and the day with the latest sunrise. All computation
happens locally in your browser: R itself runs as
[WebAssembly](https://docs.r-wasm.org/), loaded by the
[quarto-webr](https://github.com/coatless/quarto-webr) extension.

Enter a location and a year, then press **Plot**.

```{webr-r}
#| context: setup
#| message: false
```

<script type="module">
const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const logEl = $("ss-log"), plotEl = $("ss-plot"), btn = $("ss-go");

// Size of the R graphics device, in points (1/72 inch). 720pt is like
// `fig-width: 10` in Quarto. webR captures the plot as a 2x bitmap and it
// is displayed at 1x (PLOT_PTS css pixels), so it stays crisp on hi-DPI
// screens. Make this number bigger or smaller to resize the plot.
const PLOT_PTS = 720;

// Default the year input to the current year
$("ss-year").value = new Date().getFullYear();

function logLine(text, cls = "") {
  const span = document.createElement("span");
  span.textContent = text + "\n";
  if (cls) span.className = cls;
  logEl.appendChild(span);
  while (logEl.childNodes.length > 500) logEl.removeChild(logEl.firstChild);
  logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;
}

// Run R code with warnings/messages re-routed to stderr and errors
// re-thrown (so that they surface as JavaScript exceptions)
function withLogging(body) {
  return `tryCatch(
  withCallingHandlers({
${body}
  },
    warning = function(w) { cat("Warning: ", conditionMessage(w), "\\n", sep = "", file = stderr()); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") },
    message  = function(m) { cat("Note: ",    conditionMessage(m), "\\n", sep = "", file = stderr()); invokeRestart("muffleMessage") }
  ),
  error = function(e) stop(conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
)`;
}

const plotBody = (lat, lon, year, tz) => `
lat  = ${lat}
lon  = ${lon}
year = ${year}
tz   = "${tz}"

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library("suncalc")
  library("ggplot2")
  library("dplyr")
})

# Dates for the chosen year
dates = seq(as.Date(sprintf("%04d-01-01", year)), as.Date(sprintf("%04d-12-31", year)), by = "day")

# Sunrise and sunset times
suntimes = suncalc::getSunlightTimes(date = dates, lat = lat, lon = lon, tz = tz)

# Extract hour of day as decimal (e.g., 6.5 = 6:30 AM)
hour = function(x) as.numeric(format(x, "%H")) + as.numeric(format(x, "%M")) / 60 + as.numeric(format(x, "%S")) / 3600

periodicdiff = function(x) {
  x[c(2:length(x), 1)] - x
}

suntimes = dplyr::mutate(suntimes,
    sunrise = hour(sunrise),
    sunset  = hour(sunset),
    speed   = periodicdiff(sunset-sunrise) * 60
)

specialdays = bind_rows(
  dplyr::slice_min(suntimes, sunrise)[1,],
  dplyr::slice_max(suntimes, sunset)[1,],
  dplyr::slice_min(suntimes, sunset)[1,],
  dplyr::slice_max(suntimes, sunrise)[1,]
) |> bind_cols(
  what = c("EarliestDay", "Latest Night", "EarliestNight", "LatestDay"),
  hjust = c(  0,    0,   1,    1), 
  vjust = c(1.5, -0.5, 1.5, -0.5)
) |> unique()

p = ggplot(suntimes, aes(x = sunrise, y = sunset, col = speed)) +
  geom_path(col = "#707070") +
  geom_point() +
  scale_colour_gradient2(name = "change (min/day)") +
  xlab("Sunrise (hour)") + 
  ylab("Sunset (hour)") +
  ggtitle(sprintf("Sunrise vs sunset times at (%.2f, %.2f) in %d", lat, lon, year)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  geom_point(data = specialdays, col = "red")  +
  geom_text(data = specialdays, col = "black", 
            mapping = aes(hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust, label = format(date, "%d %b")))

print(p)`;

function showCapturedOutput(output) {
  for (const o of output) {
    if (typeof o.data === "string") {
      const cls = o.data.startsWith("Warning") ? "warn" : o.data.startsWith("Note") ? "note" : "";
      logLine(o.data, cls);
    } else {
      logLine(`[${o.type}]`);
    }
  }
}

function showImages(images) {
  plotEl.replaceChildren();
  for (const img of images) {
    const c = document.createElement("canvas");
    c.width = img.width;
    c.height = img.height;
    c.style.width = PLOT_PTS + "px";
    c.getContext("2d").drawImage(img, 0, 0);
    plotEl.appendChild(c);
  }
}

let shelter;
window.__runs = 0; // small counter used by automated tests

function setBusy(busy, label) {
  btn.disabled = busy;
  if (label) btn.textContent = label;
}

async function runPlot() {
  const lat = Number($("ss-lat").value);
  const lon = Number($("ss-lon").value);
  const year = Number($("ss-year").value);
  const tz = $("ss-tz").value.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_+/-]/g, "");

  if (!Number.isFinite(lat) || lat < -90 || lat > 90)  return logLine("ERROR: latitude must be between -90 and 90", "err");
  if (!Number.isFinite(lon) || lon < -180 || lon > 180) return logLine("ERROR: longitude must be between -180 and 180", "err");
  if (!Number.isInteger(year) || year < 1 || year > 9999) return logLine("ERROR: year must be an integer between 1 and 9999", "err");
  if (!tz) return logLine("ERROR: please provide a timezone (e.g., UTC)", "err");

  const code = withLogging(plotBody(lat, lon, year, tz));
  $("ss-rcode").textContent = code;

  window.__runs++;
  logLine(`— Plotting for lat = ${lat}, lon = ${lon}, year = ${year}, tz = ${tz}`);
  setBusy(true, "Plotting…");
  try {
    const cap = await shelter.captureR(code, {
      captureGraphics: { width: PLOT_PTS, height: PLOT_PTS, bg: "white", pointsize: 12, capture: true }
    });
    showCapturedOutput(cap.output);
    if (cap.images.length === 0) {
      logLine("ERROR: no plot was produced (see messages above)", "err");
    } else {
      showImages(cap.images);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    logLine("ERROR: " + (err?.message ?? String(err)), "err");
  } finally {
    await shelter.purge();
    setBusy(false, "Plot");
  }
}

(async () => {
  logLine("Loading the R WebAssembly runtime and packages (suncalc, ggplot2, dplyr)…");
  try {
    if (typeof globalThis.qwebrInstance === "undefined") {
      throw new Error("the quarto-webr extension did not initialize — is the `webr` filter enabled and the `_extensions/webr/` directory present?");
    }
    await globalThis.qwebrInstance; // webR is booted, packages installed and loaded
    shelter = globalThis.mainWebRCodeShelter;
  } catch (err) {
    logLine("ERROR: could not start webR — check your internet connection. " + (err?.message ?? String(err)), "err");
    return;
  }
  logLine("R " + await globalThis.mainWebR.evalRString("paste0(R.version$major, '.', R.version$minor)") + " is running in your browser.");
  setBusy(false, "Plot");
  btn.addEventListener("click", runPlot);
  logLine("Ready.");
  await runPlot(); // draw the default plot right away
})();
</script>
